context_requirements: RIPK1 protein expression and a stimulus that activates RIPK1-dependent signaling (e.g., TNF family ligands, TLR ligands, or SMAC mimetics)
Absence of strong compensatory survival signaling that bypasses RIPK1
For necroptosis readout: RIPK3 and MLKL expression
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines treated with a RIPK inhibitor alone
Enrichment of RIPK1-dependent inflammatory or cell-death transcriptional signatures in vehicle-treated cells that is reversed by the inhibitor
Consistent transcriptional response across all nine lines despite differing RIPK1 pathway status
